verdict.rationale: Publishing independent security audits is a fair question for a password manager, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions third-party audits, penetration tests or audit reports covering the app or its sync protocol. The pack covers TOTP, import/export, CLI, APIs, an MCP server and vault health reports, none of which are independent audits, and the community items do not address audits either.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the vendor publishes independent security audits of the app and its sync protocol
